sentences.text: BETWEEN:-
BINDRA @ ARVIND BEN S/O SHRI HIRALAL BEN, AGED  ABOUT 25 YEARS, OCCUPATION: PRIVATE JOB R/O
VILLAGE MATAMAR POLICE STATION KHAMARIYA  DISTT. JABALPUR (MADHYA PRADESH)

(BY MS SAVITA CHOUDHARY - ADVOCATE)
 AND

THE STATE OF MADHYA PRADESH THROUGH POLICE  STATION KHAMARIYA DISTRICT JABALPUR (MADHYA  PRADESH)
 
 (BY SHRI PUNIT SHROTI - GOVERNMENT ADVOCATE)

This application coming on for admission this day, the   following:
 ORDER

This is the fourth application filed by the applicant under Section 439 of the Code of Criminal Procedure for grant of bail relating to FIR No.158/2022 dated (not mentioned) registered at Police Station Khamariya District Jabalpur, for the offence under Sections 376(D) & 376(2) of IPC.
Earlier application of the applicant was dismissed as withdrawn vide order dated 09/05/2023.
Counsel for the applicant submits that applicant is in jail since 01/06/2022.

She further submits that applicant has also filed the order sheets indicating that despite making all endeavour by the Court below prosecutrix is not coming to the Court for getting her statement recorded.
On these grounds, she prays for grant of bail to the applicant.

sentences.text: Per contra, counsel for State has opposed the prayer for grant of bail.
Considering the arguments advanced by counsel for the parties, perusal of case diary and perusal of order sheets of the Court below, I am inclined to enlarge the applicant on bail.
Therefore, without commenting anything on the merits of the case, this application is allowed.

It is directed that the applicant be released on bail upon his furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.1,00,000/- (Rupees one Lac) with one solvent surety of the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court concerned for his appearance on the dates given by it.

I t is further directed that the applicant shall abide by the conditions enumerated in Section 437(3)
of the Code of Criminal Procedure.
Certified copy as per rules.

(SANJAY DWIVEDI) JUDGE sushma Bindra @ Arvind Ben vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 18 August, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/103692696/
